item: platform/batch by tissue and P level
question: Leaf libraries were sequenced on HiSeq 4000 (UC Berkeley) and root libraries on NextSeq 550 (Labsergen); within leaves, lane batch DRRS001 holds every full-P library and DRRS002 every low-P library. N contrasts are within tissue and within P level, so they are not confounded; P main effects in leaf are confounded with lane batch. OK to use N contrasts within each tissue x P level?
proposed_answer: Yes: build N contrasts (LowN vs Full, LowNP vs LowP) within tissue and P level only; record the batch caveat for any P or tissue comparison.
evidence: BioSample sample_fastq DRRS001_* = fullN_fullP/lowN_fullP, DRRS002_* = fullN_lowP/lowN_lowP; instrument column in runs.tsv; Methods (RNA-seq section)

question: Only 2 biological replicates (single plants) per tissue x treatment. Keep the study for pooling?
proposed_answer: Keep; SEs will be large and the meta-analysis weights will reflect that.
evidence: Methods: 2 tissues x 4 treatments x 2 replicates = 16 samples; Results: two individuals per treatment

question: The 16 wild-type runs are curated here only; AlonsoNieves2022 reuses them as its WT reference. Contrast building for AlonsoNieves2022 genotype effects must pull these samples from this study without double-counting N effects in pooling.
proposed_answer: Count WT N contrasts once (under TorresRodriguez2021); AlonsoNieves2022 contributes only het/hom N contrasts.
evidence: runs.tsv also_used_by = AlonsoNieves2022; AlonsoNieves2022 Methods: separate analysis of WT libraries published previously
